Theorem
[Mostow rigidity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0213 1. ch31:31.49\group Mostow rigidity

If two finite-volume hyperbolic manifolds of dimension at least three have isomorphic fundamental groups, there is a unique isometry inducing the given isomorphism.
